row.evidence: Genesys Cloud SCIM (Identity Management) uses SCIM APIs to sync user entities from identity management systems (Entra ID, Okta, OneLogin) to Genesys Cloud; the SCIM docs and the CX 1-4 pricing matrix set no licence tier or add-on for it.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Plans: CX 1 $75, CX 2 $115, CX 3 $155, CX 4 $240 per user/month billed annually (named-user; concurrent and hourly models also offered). SCIM is a platform API feature with no documented licence gate or add-on, so it is recorded on CX 1; the gate is inferred from that absence (no page says 'all plans'), hence medium confidence. SSO also has no documented tier, so sso_plan stays null. SCIM is one-way, cannot create groups, and IdP unassignment sets users inactive (hard delete deletes them). sso_required_for_scim is false because the SCIM token comes from an OAuth client, not from SSO configuration.

plans.name: Genesys Cloud CX 1
plans.notes: SSO and SCIM are not rows in the pricing comparison matrix; no licence gate for either is documented in the help centre.

auth.token_source: Genesys Cloud OAuth client (Client Credentials grant); the access token is pasted into the IdP as the bearer token
auth.notes: Entra's tutorial says long-lived bearer tokens are supported; the OAuth token lifetime is not stated in the SCIM docs.

operations.notes: Groups cannot be created or deleted over SCIM; only membership of existing public groups with matching names is synced (Okta Push Groups, Entra group provisioning).

deprovision.data_retained: Inactive users keep their assigned roles and are restored on reactivation; a hard delete in the IdP deletes the Genesys Cloud user, and re-enabling a deleted user does not restore its roles.
deprovision.notes: Unassigning (Okta) or removing from scope / soft-deleting (Entra) sets the user inactive; Entra's later hard delete deletes the user. Both inactive and deleted users cannot access the org.

pagination.notes: startIndex/count; default count 25, and pages over 25 may hit internal limits and return 429 unless attributes are excluded.

custom.how: No arbitrary custom attributes are documented; a Genesys extension (urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:genesys:purecloud:2.0:User) carries routingSkills and routingLanguages (name, proficiency).

attributes.notes: name.givenName, name.familyName and addresses are listed as not supported by Genesys Cloud. Entra's mapping also uses a Microsoft Teams externalIds extension attribute.

roles.how: roles attribute (roles.[].value) maps to the user roles API; Genesys also recommends assigning roles to groups and syncing group membership.

rate_limits.text: List requests with a page size over 25 may exceed internal resource limits and return 429.

limitations.text: One-way only: changes made in Genesys Cloud are not synced back and may be overwritten.
Cannot create or delete groups; only public groups with names matching the IdP group are synced.
Blocks any single action that removes more than 1000 members from a group (Okta Push Now behaviour).
name.givenName, name.familyName and address attributes are not supported.
Re-enabling a user deleted in Genesys Cloud does not restore the default employee role or manually added roles.

scim.notes: SCIM is a platform feature configured with an OAuth client; neither the SCIM docs nor the pricing matrix tie it to a CX tier, so scim.plan stays null. A legacy path without /v2 (/api/v2/scim/users) is also listed in the SDK docs. {domain} is the region API host, e.g. api.mypurecloud.com.

auth.notes: OAuth clients (client credentials and user grants). SCIM calls use the 'scim' / 'scim:readonly' scopes; Platform API permissions such as directory:user:delete are role-based.

capabilities.notes: Users have states active, inactive and deleted; the docs list state as a filter, but a documented deactivate call outside SCIM was not confirmed.

endpoints.purpose: Get the list of available users
Send an activation email to the user
List roles defined for the organization
Get a page of users and their licenses
Update the organization's license assignments in a batch

user_api.notes: Plan inferred from the pricing page's fair-use allowance, which includes API calls on all plans.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SWA, SCIM with Create, Update, Deactivate, Sync Password, Group Push and Group Linking (read from page markup).

entra.notes: Gallery app 'Genesys Cloud for Azure' (formerly PureCloud by Genesys).

onelogin.notes: From Genesys's own OneLogin SCIM guide (OneLogin app named 'PureCloud'); OneLogin catalogue page not loaded.

jumpcloud.notes: Not listed among the identity management systems known to work with Genesys Cloud SCIM; not checked in JumpCloud's catalogue.

fallbacks.notes: SSO requires the user's email to already exist in Genesys Cloud, so SSO does not create users.
